verdict.rationale: Jira's own Rovo AI is documented to automatically assign broken-down tasks to the right person, which covers the routing part of triage. Rovo can also create custom automation rules that move work forward. However, nothing shows AI prioritizing work or triaging incoming bug reports specifically. The 'Prioritize high-impact work' claim is not tied to AI. Missing for 10: AI-driven prioritization or severity scoring, explicit triage of incoming bugs and requests, depth docs on how Rovo triage works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI
Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
